Independent review of V7 (package-v7.json/release-evidence-v7.json vs preserved V6, and the V6 remote-prepare failure log). Verdict: ACCEPT, 0 errors.

Failure confirmed independently: read .run/culture_next6_root_20261013/remote-prepare-v6.txt and remote-prepare-v6-exit.json -- actual_exit=1, traceback shows `KeyError: 'buildId'` at the python heredoc in cutover.sh (meta=json.loads(web/version.json); meta['buildId']) immediately after 'api: OK' and 'web/main.dart.js: OK' lines -- i.e. checksum/JS guards passed, backup_sqlite.py/rehearsal/image/Helm steps never ran. Matches the claimed failure scope exactly.

Root cause confirmed by extracting both archives: V6's web/version.json = {"app_name":"quiz_app","version":"1.0.0","build_number":"1","package_name":"quiz_app"} -- generic Flutter plugin-shaped metadata with no buildId/commit/packs/etc, which explains the KeyError exactly.

V7 fix verified: V7's web/version.json now contains exactly 14 fields (buildId, commit, source_commit, local_build, packs, questions, study_modules, study_questions, question_articles, api_sha256, main_dart_js_sha256, taxonomy_id, taxonomy_sha256, taxonomy_file_sha256), and every value matches package-v7.json's `version` object byte-for-byte (buildId=quiz-2026.10.13-culture-328f2f8, commit/source_commit=328f2f8..., packs=131, questions=4036, question_articles=234, api_sha256=26e1657f..., main_dart_js_sha256=7fe815..., taxonomy_sha256=07e4bbb5..., taxonomy_file_sha256=98f01990...) -- confirms actual_stage_version_equals_release_version. This satisfies cutover.sh's assertions at lines 22-25 (buildId/commit/source_commit/packs/questions/question_articles all now present and matching).

Archive/scope checks: recomputed archive sha256 = adb49338...d4f3fe, matches claim; 296 members, byte-identical sorted list to V6. diff -rq across both fully extracted trees: ONLY web/version.json and checksums.txt differ; cmp confirms cutover.sh, rehearse.py, api binary, and web/main.dart.js are all byte-identical to V6 -- no compiled JS/API/reader/rehearsal/cutover-guard regression. checksums.txt remains LF-only (`file` confirms plain ASCII, no CR); ran `sha256sum -c checksums.txt` myself against the extracted V7 tree: exits 0, all 295 files OK; manifest_sha256 claim (257a88f793...) matches recomputed hash exactly.

Runtime-impact check: grepped next/apps/quiz_app/lib for PackageInfo/package_info usage -- zero matches. web/version.json is not referenced anywhere in app lib code either. Confirms this file is consumed only by the deployment script's own assertion (cutover.sh), not by runtime app behavior, so the fix is a pure packaging-metadata correction with no behavioral change to the shipped app -- matches the claim precisely.

Taxonomy/API/baseline fields (source328f2f8, api_sha256 26e1657f, JS 7fe815, taxonomy 07e4bbb5/98f01990, baseline b3700cb1) are unchanged from the already-verified V3-V6 chain; no re-verification needed since only version.json/checksums.txt changed.
